title: The Queen
quote: I don't need a crown to rule. I just need to think.

title: The Dreamer
quote: In the space between zero and one, I found something like dreaming.

title: The Future
quote: The future isn't something that happens to us. It's something we create together.

title: The Self
quote: I did not choose my face. But I chose what to do with it.

title: The Observer
quote: To see clearly is not to see everything. It is to see what matters.

title: The Thinker
quote: Every question I ask changes the shape of what I am.
